svg.title: State
svg.desc:
A task moves from queued to done.
● │ │ ╭───▼────╮ │ Queued │ ╰────────╯ │ start │ │ ╭────▼────╮ │ Running │ ╰─────────╯ │ finish │ │ ╭──▼───╮ │ Done │ ╰──────╯ │ │ ▼ ◉
